title: Terrarium Crucible
name: terrarium_crucible
short_description: Shrink into a wizard's glass terrarium! Care for magical plants, clear falling fire and ice blocks, pave speed paths, and grow your garden!
long_description:
**Terrarium Crucible** is a cozy yet lively action-puzzle gardening game created for the **2026 Luanti Game Jam** (*The Wizard's Workshop*).

You have been shrunk down to the size of a thimble and placed inside an open-top glass terrarium on a wizard's wooden desk, surrounded by tall flickering candles and an open spellbook. Solo or together with friends, your goal is to care for delicate magical plants called **Crucible Sprouts** while the wizard drops wild ingredients in from above!

### How It Plays

- **Grow & Open New Glass Rooms**: You begin in one cozy glass room caring for a single sprout. Keep the air comfortable and the soil clean until your garden reaches **100% Bloom**, pick **1 of 3 Next-Level Blessings** to power your next stage, and watch brass-framed archways open into a brand-new room with another plant!
- **Simple Tools, Satisfying Combos**: Glowing circles on the soil warn you before fiery **Brimstone**, frosty **Ice**, sour **Acid Slime**, or dry **Chalk** land. Clear them with your hotbar tools (`[1]`–`[4]`), swat them out of mid-air for bonus plant growth, or scoop up one block with your **Trowel `[1]`** and set it beside its opposite so both vanish in a burst of sparkles!
- **Easy Refills & Never-Stuck Design**: Your **Bellows `[2]`**, **Water Flask `[3]`**, and **Pestle `[4]`** start pre-charged, gain extra capacity every two levels, refill right from matching blocks in the garden, and even let you click the air when empty for a quick backup charge.
- **Speed Paths, Bonus Crystals & Lifesaver Potions**: Cleaning up acid or chalk turns dirt into glowing green **Fertile Soil** that speeds up plant growth and lets you dash between rooms. Crack open shimmering **Prismatic Geodes** to clear nearby messes, refill all your tools, and earn an **Aegis Potion** (which heals, shields, revives wilted plants, and even saves you automatically from a knockout hit) alongside time-pausing **Chronos Hourglasses**!
- **Welcoming for Everyone**: Includes an illustrated 5-tab **Guidebook `[5]`**, three pace modes (**Casual**, **Normal**, and **Panic**) you can switch anytime by **Right-Clicking any Plant**, co-op room callouts (`[Z]`), a **Top 10 Leaderboard** with copyable run summaries, and full translations in **9 languages**.

*Credits: Pixel-art textures and menu artwork created with Google Gemini 3.1 Pro & Google Imagen (directed and curated by SaKeL, CC0 1.0); sound effects from Freesound.org contributors (CC0 1.0).*
